summary: Open a path with the desktop default application and return Electron's error-string convention.

target.notes: Uses native OS integration without requiring Chromium.

caveats: Do not translate to Task with exception-only failure: Electron resolves to an error string for ordinary openPath failure.

tests.name: open success
tests.expected_behavior: resolves to empty string on success

tests.name: open failure string
tests.expected_behavior: resolves to a non-empty failure message rather than necessarily rejecting
